title: First bad coordinate
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $\varphi$ be a DNF formula on $\{\pm1\}^n$, and let $\rho$ be a coordinate restriction for which the restricted formula is nonconstant. The first bad coordinate is the least coordinate in the nonempty set of free coordinates compatible with a term witnessing this nonconstancy.
caveat: The definition of the compatible free support set is referenced but not supplied, so its exact membership condition cannot be stated from the provided snippet.
